text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First place in the Satsuki Sho slips through Narita Brian's fingers. Realizing her shortcomings, she resolves not to lose next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she doesn't take first, her performance still impacts the other racers. The press dubs her "the Beast" in the ensuing articles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian, however, is completely focused on her next goal—the Japanese Derby.
